body:
WHAT
The OVERDRIVE self-check (finishing.self-verify, still OVERDRIVE-only, still once per turn) is told what the turn left open instead of having to find it.
- Symptoms: after each model call that ends in tool calls, the engine keeps the sentences of that response's text that report a failure (never / does not / doesn't / isn't / won't / can't / cannot / fails / failed / broken / crashed / throws / stuck / no longer), at most six per turn, each shortened to 200 characters, duplicates dropped (findSymptoms). When the self-check fires they are quoted in a clause of its closing (finishing.self-verify.symptoms): each is settled only when it was re-tested after its fix, and one passing case does not settle another.
- Hedges: the final answer's sentences that hedge — may/might/could still, not (yet) verified/tested/checked/confirmed, unverified, untested, could not / couldn't verify/test/run/confirm/check, should work, probably works, not sure — at most five (findHedges) are quoted in a second clause (finishing.self-verify.hedges): settle each now if possible (run it, check it, clean it up), or keep it as a plain note to the user; "may still" must never stand in for a cleanup the model could do itself.
- The code closing (finishing.self-verify.closing-code) gains one sentence: when a fix corrected a mistake that can be repeated elsewhere (a misspelled or wrongly cased name, a wrong call), search every file for it.
- Both clauses are empty when there is nothing to quote, so a clean turn pays nothing. The rung keeps its one {{closing}} slot, last; the clauses ride inside it.
- Normal mode is unchanged: an attended turn is read by its user (decided 2026-07-26).

WHY
Field test 2026-09-23, findings V-02, V-03, V-04. At 18:48:57 the agent reported "The player never kills anything and enemies never damage the player"; 32 s later it claimed "combat confirmed working" from one kill — the second symptom was never re-checked (the real cause, Player.Update never called, was found at 18:52:24). The 11-second self-check said "verified — nothing left to do" while the final answer said "two stray test sessions may still be registered server-side"; at 19:06:32 those sessions filled the server's 8 slots and it refused new ones with HTTP 429. And the .Value/.value bug class was fixed where it was seen, not searched for across the files.

WHERE
engine/core/src/runtime/finishing.ts — findSymptoms(), findHedges(), SELF_VERIFY_SYMPTOMS, SELF_VERIFY_HEDGES, SELF_VERIFY_CLOSING_CODE, selfVerifyText(changedCode, open). engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — the per-turn symptom list, filled in the tool branch of the turn loop and passed to the self-verify rung with the final answer's hedges.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. (pure) The two clause prompts are registered reminders with the slots symptoms and hedges; the code closing asks to search every file for a repeated mistake; none of them demands a passing result.
2. (fs) Replay of the field shape in OVERDRIVE: a tool round whose text says "The player never kills anything and enemies never damage the player.", then a final answer saying "Combat confirmed working. Two stray test sessions may still be registered server-side." The self-check request quotes the symptom and the hedge; the final answer's confident sentence is not quoted as a hedge.
3. (fs) A clean OVERDRIVE turn — no failure reported, no hedge — gets the self-check without either clause.
